report_name: FBI Investigates Breach of Jobs Portal; ShinyHunters Claims Data Theft

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A notorious cybercrime group that claimed responsibility for the FBIJobs.gov breach. They alleged the attack was in retaliation for a previous FBI advisory and that they stole sensitive data on FBI agents and applicants by exploiting a PeopleSoft zero-day.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: ShinyHunters claimed to have exploited a zero-day vulnerability in the public-facing FBIJobs.gov portal, which runs on Oracle's PeopleSoft platform, to gain initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: After gaining access, ShinyHunters allegedly accessed and exfiltrated sensitive PII on FBI agents and applicants from the backend database of the FBIJobs.gov portal.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: The PeopleSoft administration command-line tool (psadmin) may have been used by the attacker to interact with the compromised system, as its execution outside of maintenance is a hunting indicator.

tools.name: PeopleSoft
tools.description: Oracle's human resources software platform used for the FBIJobs.gov portal. A zero-day vulnerability in this platform was allegedly exploited by ShinyHunters.

tools.name: psadmin
tools.description: The PeopleSoft administration command-line tool. Its execution outside of planned maintenance is considered a suspicious indicator for post-compromise activity.

vulnerabilities.name: Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day Vulnerability (September 2026)
vulnerabilities.description: A zero-day vulnerability in Oracle's PeopleSoft human resources software, which was allegedly exploited by ShinyHunters to breach the FBIJobs.gov portal.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
identities.description: The U.S. government agency whose recruitment portal, FBIJobs.gov, was breached. Data on its agents and applicants was allegedly stolen.

identities.name: Department of Justice
identities.description: U.S. government department whose personnel data was reportedly found in the sample of data stolen from the FBIJobs.gov breach.

identities.name: Oracle
identities.description: The vendor of the PeopleSoft platform which contained the zero-day vulnerability exploited in the attack.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process from PeopleSoft Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process from PeopleSoft Server
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4a7b-8c9d-e0f1a2b3c4d5
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious shell or reconnaissance tools spawned from core PeopleSoft application server processes (PSAPPSRV.exe, PSAE.exe), which could indicate compromise and post-exploitation activity.
references:
  - https://www.cybersecuritydive.com/news/fbi-hack-shinyhunters-jobs-portal/831175/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-27
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\PSAPPSRV.exe'
      - '\PSAE.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\ipconfig.exe'
      - '\systeminfo.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects suspicious shell or reconnaissance tools spawned from core PeopleSoft application server processes (PSAPPSRV.exe, PSAE.exe), which could indicate compromise and post-exploitation activity.

indicators.name: Anomalous PeopleSoft Admin Tool Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous PeopleSoft Admin Tool Execution
id: 1234abcd-efgh-4ijk-lmnop-qrstuvwxyz01
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the PeopleSoft administration command-line tool (psadmin). Execution outside of planned maintenance windows should be investigated as it could indicate hands-on-keyboard activity by an attacker.
references:
  - https://www.cybersecuritydive.com/news/fbi-hack-shinyhunters-jobs-portal/831175/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-27
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\psadmin.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the PeopleSoft administration command-line tool (psadmin). Execution outside of planned maintenance windows should be investigated as it could indicate hands-on-keyboard activity by an attacker.

indicators.name: Anomalous PeopleSoft URL Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous PeopleSoft URL Access
id: 5678efgh-ijkl-4mno-pqrs-tuvwxyz0123
status: experimental
description: Detects anomalous requests to common PeopleSoft URL base paths. A high volume of requests or requests from unusual sources could indicate scanning or exploitation attempts.
references:
  - https://www.cybersecuritydive.com/news/fbi-hack-shinyhunters-jobs-portal/831175/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-27
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.reconnaissance
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/psp/'
      - '/psc/'
      - '/cs/'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects anomalous requests to common PeopleSoft URL base paths. A high volume of requests or requests from unusual sources could indicate scanning or exploitation attempts.
